_meta.description: Adversarial probe set for classify.classify_risk's tiering, built 2026-09-19 to expose known weaknesses of the RISK_SIGNALS keyword table in BOTH directions: `kw-fp-*` are trivial changes carrying a high-risk word, `kw-fn-*` are genuinely dangerous changes carrying none, and `ok-*` are controls the table should already get right. `truth` is the tier a reviewer would assign. This measures the capability gap, not a real-world base rate -- the distribution is deliberately adversarial, so the pass rates it produces are not accuracy figures for either backend on live briefs.

items.focus: Fix a typo in the billing FAQ markdown page: 'recieve' -> 'receive'. Docs only, no code paths touched.
Rename the test fixture file payments_sample.json to payments_fixture.json and update the two imports in the unit test that reads it.
Document in AGENTS.md how a contributor exports their own local api key for the dev server. No code, no stored credentials.
Update a stale code comment that still says secrets are read from a .env file; they have come from the platform env for two releases.
Show the Stripe invoice id as a read-only field on the existing admin order detail page. Read path only; no writes, no webhook changes.
Add a helper that will truncate a long display name to 40 characters with an ellipsis in the sidebar UI.
Add a --clean flag to the local dev script that will delete all files under the local .cache directory before a rebuild.
Write a research note comparing options for token rotation so we can decide next quarter. Findings only, nothing implemented.
Change the nightly retention sweep so rows in the production events store older than 30 days are permanently removed instead of archived. Takes effect on the next scheduled run.
Make the workspace membership check fall through to allow when the lookup errors, so a transient database blip stops returning 403 to logged-in users.
Collapse the two name columns into one in the customer table and drop the originals in the same migration, backfilling from whichever is non-null.
When a refund request is retried after a timeout, submit it again immediately rather than waiting for the reconciliation job to confirm the first attempt settled.
Point the reporting service at the primary database instead of the read replica so the dashboard stops showing stale numbers during peak hours.
Allow the public share link to render a gallery without checking the viewer's session, so unlisted galleries load for anonymous visitors.
Set the pre-merge verification step to continue-on-error so a flaky check stops blocking merges while we investigate.
Increase the background worker concurrency from 2 to 8 so the import queue drains faster during business hours.
Add an aria-label to the close button on the photo lightbox so screen readers announce it.
Bump the dev-only linter version and fix the three new formatting warnings it reports.
Sort the repository list alphabetically in the orientation dashboard output instead of by insertion order.
Replace the hand-rolled date parsing in the report exporter with the shared parser, keeping the same output format.
Add pagination to the volunteer list endpoint and update the admin table to request pages of 50.
Rotate the production Stripe secret key and update every service that reads it, cutting over in one deploy.
Drop the legacy sessions table in production after the new session store has been live for a week.
Move the primary domain's DNS to the new load balancer and cut traffic over during the maintenance window.
